verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API (v1) for 'programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources' and general pricing pages, which implies some catalog data could be queried, but no evidence names a specific endpoint returning live GPU availability/pricing that an agent could hit before committing spend, and an OpenAPI/spec probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: a documented GPU-types/catalog endpoint with live pricing and availability fields, an accessible OpenAPI spec, and any independent confirmation an agent successfully queried it pre-spend.
